title: Sleep-disordered Breathing Database
official: Enhancing Patient Care: Sleep and Ventilation Database
summary: The goal of this study is to collect clinical data on patients who have had a sleep study and are given a diagnosis of a sleep related breathing disorder such as obstructive sleep apnoea. Collecting this data in an organised way will mean that the investigators can monitor patients and their health outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>18 years
* Referred to Royal Free London NHS Foundation Trust Sleep and Ventilation Service
* Agreed to undertake a sleep study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to consent
sponsor: Royal Free Hospital NHS Foundation Trust

sites.f: Royal Free London NHS Foundation Trust
